# Kwikey Locksmith

> Locksmith services from one Wilmington, Delaware storefront, with mobile coverage across Delaware and nearby Pennsylvania service areas since 2009.

## About

Kwikey Locksmith is an insured locksmith company with one Delaware storefront at 211 Maryland Ave in Wilmington. We provide emergency, residential, commercial, and automotive locksmith service with price factors reviewed before approved work starts.

Pennsylvania pages describe mobile service coverage from the Delaware operation only. They do not represent Pennsylvania offices or branches, storefronts, shops, or staffed locations.

- **Phone**: (302) 551-2550
- **Email**: kwikeylocksmithoffice@gmail.com
- **Address**: 211 Maryland Ave, Wilmington, DE 19805
- **Hours**: Storefront Monday-Friday 9:00 AM-4:00 PM; mobile service hours vary by day.
- **Website**: https://www.kwikeylocksmith.com/

## Services

- [Emergency Locksmith](https://www.kwikeylocksmith.com/services/emergency/): House lockout, car lockout, business lockout, broken key extraction, lock change after break-in, emergency lock repair
- [Residential Locksmith](https://www.kwikeylocksmith.com/services/residential/): Lock installation, rekeying, lock repair, smart locks, deadbolt installation, mailbox lock replacement
- [Commercial Locksmith](https://www.kwikeylocksmith.com/services/commercial/): Master key systems, access control, high-security locks, commercial lock change, panic bar installation, safe lockout
- [Automotive Locksmith](https://www.kwikeylocksmith.com/services/automotive/): Car key replacement, transponder key programming, ignition repair, car key duplication
